none: PAS FindID 1016684: Roman coin: possibly a radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, the finder kindly suggests of Carausius (286-293); if so, Reece period 14. Obverse description: Bull-necked bust laureate cuirassed right, seen from the front. Obverse inscription: IMP[---]A[---]AV[G]. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left holding a ?bag or loop?, altar to right. Obverse inscription: [---] IA [AVG]. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 3.39gms, die axis: 6
